fixture_policy: Isolated wallet, director and malformed-record fixtures may set actor positions or damaged structures. Actual watch, duel and battle replays use shared Simulation/Session with validated inputs and fixed steps; no direct HP, position, resource, rule or timer rewrites. Whole-night success is additionally verified by the same-tree P5 regression under p6-p5-regression prefix.
